text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Out on an excursion with Yaeno Muteki.
Per her "earnest request,"
we ended up heading to a certain mountain.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for bringing you all the way out here.
The truth is... I found out that my missing senior fellow disciple is here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I... know of someone.
Someone who has reached that very same realm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My senior apprentice who, having perfected martial arts, was consumed by nihilism and abandoned our school—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now... I feel like I can convey something to that person.
...I've come to be able to believe that."
choice_data_list: Still, on a mountain this huge, can we really find it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We've already 'been found.'
Ever since we entered the mountain... someone has been watching us the whole time.

âHoh. Heard you went into racing, but...
Seems you haven't dulled one bit, surprisingly enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the next moment... a large Umamusume wearing a tattered dogi tied with a rough straw rope dropped down from the trees!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Long time no see. ...I was surprised. When I heard you were in a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text: "...What else was I supposed to do? I did everything I could in civilization. To shake off this emptiness, my only choice was to take on Mother Nature herself."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Was there truly no other way?
A way other than living like this, merely quenching your thirst for a fleeting moment—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Simply continuing to hone one's "martial arts," serving as a guidepost for disciples
who look up to their senior... Such a way of life...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"Heh. What's the point of chasing after someone
who's lost sight of their own path?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text: "...Someday, you might understand how I feel too. Even if you master the path of racing, in the end it leads to the same emptiness—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Don't screw with me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I learned it in the world of racing!
As long as I have comrades to compete with and elevate one another,
the path will never come to an end!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The next generation, too, will look upon our journey and find their own path forward...
Human connection itself is what creates the road!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You have comrades at your dojo, don't you?!
Juniors who look up to you, too! And even those you've defeated must still be training hard, waiting for a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Disregarding all of that, what's with this 'nothingness' crap?!
Stop spouting your selfish nonsense!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Cheeky as ever, aren't you.
So, you came all this way just to lecture me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nay! It is to demonstrate the growth born of human bonds... and show the proof of it!
Therefore, I--

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
âI shall parry it flawlessly!
Your ultimate, all-out strike!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What she wanted to convey to that person"—
It seems it wasn't words, but a method of communication shared only between fellow warriors.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I know the risks! But have no fear!
Within me reside your teachings...
the teachings of my Master!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I'm not tasteless enough to turn down
a challenge from a serious opponent.
And besides... I won't go easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And lowering her center of gravity into a stance...
radiating a terrifying bloodlust, the senior disciple
crept inch by inch toward Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...No shadow, no sound, and no foe left standing once unleashed.
The pinnacle of counter-striking... That is the Yaegaki "Secret Technique."
However... there is no fear in my heart!)
choice_data_list: ...Believe in everything you've learned up until now!
...Believe in everything you've learned up until now!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed—for by my Master's side,
I have conquered fierce battles against mighty foes before!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Raging 'hellfire' and tranquil 'still waters'.
The instant the balance broke, blown backward
yet still overpowering the opponent's technique was—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Guh...gh!!
*pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text: "...'Still Water', huh. Is that... the strength you gained from your supposed 'bonds' with others?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...*Cough*. The memories of everyone I've met...
In that moment, they bestowed upon me
the secret technique of water."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"'Wherever you go, consider all you meet your masters.'
...Looking at you reminded me of what my master once told me. ......"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
Returning to my roots... huh. I'll redo my training from square one.
...I gotta go back to the dojo and bow my head to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...The reason I was able to serve as a 'master' to my senior
is because I had good 'masters' around me as well."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My master, my friends, and... my Trainer-dono.
choice_data_list: Then to me, you're a “master” as well.
Then, you're a "master" to me too.
Will Senpai be alright going forward?
I wonder if Senpai will be okay from now on?
At this rate, you could start your own school of martial arts...
At this rate, you could start your own school of martial arts...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My master, my friends, and... my Trainer-dono.
choice_data_list: Then to me, you're a “master” as well.
Then, you're a "master" to me too.
Will Senpai be alright going forward?
I wonder if Senpai will be okay from now on?
At this rate, you could start your own school of martial arts...
At this rate, you could start your own school of martial arts...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
! It feels presumptuous to say, but...
Indeed, that could be considered a truth in itself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
......
Acting as mirrors to elevate one another... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps that is... the ideal master-disciple relationship... Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... with Yaeno Muteki wearing a bright
and radiant smile, we returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. Now that your doubts are cleared, there is nothing to worry about. You will surely grow even stronger... Next time, I may not be able to parry your technique.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...As you continue walking your path ahead,
I am certain you will meet those
who have lost their own."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"At times like that, I want to continue being someone
who can be a 'master' to them.
Right now, I truly believe that from the bottom of my heart..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... with Yaeno Muteki wearing a bright
and radiant smile, we returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, someone like me still has a long way to go.
At the very least, until I achieve my grand goal,
I couldn't possibly do something like that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. My goal is to one day
receive full mastery from you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Um, for the sake of that boundless goal... I shall continue to devote myself to training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... with Yaeno Muteki wearing a bright
and radiant smile, we returned to the academy.
